_comment: Per-column feature dictionary, generated by scripts/extend_ontology.py from the same table that authors the ontology value_col nodes. Do not hand-edit: rerun the script.

HUNVFlag.label: Low-vehicle-access tract
HUNVFlag.definition: Share of the residential buffer in tracts where >=100 households have no vehicle and are beyond half a mile from a supermarket.

LATracts1.label: Low-access tract (1 mi)
LATracts1.definition: Share of the residential buffer in tracts flagged low-access to a supermarket at 1 mile.

LILATracts_1And10.label: Low-income & low-access tract (1/10 mi)
LILATracts_1And10.definition: Share of the residential buffer in tracts flagged low-income and low-access at 1 mile (urban) / 10 miles (rural).

LowIncomeTracts.label: Low-income tract
LowIncomeTracts.definition: Share of the residential buffer in tracts meeting the USDA low-income criterion (poverty rate >=20% or median family income below the area threshold).

NatWalkInd.label: National Walkability Index
NatWalkInd.definition: Relative walkability from the EPA National Walkability Index (1-20).

dist_area_m.label: Distance to area feature
dist_area_m.definition: Distance in meters to the nearest NHD area feature.

dist_blue_m.label: Distance to nearest blue feature
dist_blue_m.definition: Distance in meters to the nearest combined blue feature (flowline, waterbody, area, or coast).

dist_coast_m.label: Distance to coastline
dist_coast_m.definition: Distance in meters to the nearest coastline (99999 for inland addresses).

dist_flow_m.label: Distance to flowline
dist_flow_m.definition: Distance in meters to the nearest NHD flowline.

dist_pri.label: Distance to primary road
dist_pri.definition: Distance in meters to the nearest TIGER/Line primary road (S1100).

dist_prisec.label: Distance to primary/secondary road
dist_prisec.definition: Distance in meters to the nearest TIGER/Line primary or secondary road.

dist_sec.label: Distance to secondary road
dist_sec.definition: Distance in meters to the nearest TIGER/Line secondary road (S1200).

dist_water_m.label: Distance to waterbody
dist_water_m.definition: Distance in meters to the nearest NHD waterbody.

l50dba_exi.label: Noise — existing conditions
l50dba_exi.definition: Existing-conditions daytime road+aviation transportation-noise surface, L50 dBA.

l50dba_imp.label: Noise — alternative scenario (imp)
l50dba_imp.definition: Alternative-scenario daytime L50 transportation-noise surface (dBA); exact scenario pending verification against the BTS source.

l50dba_nat.label: Noise — alternative scenario (nat)
l50dba_nat.definition: Alternative-scenario daytime L50 transportation-noise surface (dBA); exact scenario pending verification against the BTS source.

ndi.label: Neighborhood Deprivation Index score
ndi.definition: Neighborhood Deprivation Index — composite socioeconomic deprivation score (z-score).

r_bowling.label: Bowling centers
r_bowling.definition: Number of establishments in bowling centers per 10,000 population.

r_business.label: Business associations
r_business.definition: Number of establishments in business associations per 10,000 population.

r_civic.label: Civic & social associations
r_civic.definition: Number of establishments in civic and social associations per 10,000 population.

r_golf.label: Golf courses & country clubs
r_golf.definition: Number of establishments in golf courses and country clubs per 10,000 population.

r_labor.label: Labor organizations
r_labor.definition: Number of establishments in labor organizations per 10,000 population.

r_political.label: Political organizations
r_political.definition: Number of establishments in political organizations per 10,000 population.

r_professional.label: Professional organizations
r_professional.definition: Number of establishments in professional organizations per 10,000 population.

r_recreational.label: Fitness & recreational sports centers
r_recreational.definition: Number of establishments in fitness and recreational sports centers per 10,000 population.

r_religious.label: Religious organizations
r_religious.definition: Number of establishments in religious organizations per 10,000 population.

r_sports.label: Sports teams & clubs
r_sports.definition: Number of establishments in sports teams and clubs per 10,000 population.

uvief.label: UV index at noon
uvief.definition: Ultraviolet index at local solar noon.

value.label: Night-time radiance
value.definition: Annual mean night-time light radiance (nanowatts/cm^2/sr) from the VIIRS Day/Night Band.
